title: Privacy
analyticsHelp: Which screens and features are used, so we know what to improve. Off unless you switch it on. Not linked to your name and never used for advertising.
crashHelp: When the app fails, a technical report of what went wrong (device model, app version, the failing code). Off unless you switch it on.
never: We never sell data or track you across other apps. Chat, names and club details are never included.

ask.title: Usage statistics and crash reports
ask.body: May the app send these? Both are off unless you say yes, and the game works the same either way.
ask.note: You can switch either one on or off at any time in Settings, under Privacy.

update.title: Update required
update.body: This version of the app no longer works with the game server. Install the latest version to keep playing; your progress and account are kept.
